bit: It's Saturday and I treated the whole weekend like a free autopsy. Twenty-eight packs. The Monday autopsy is still warm. I brought a new toilet joke to a door that has been locked since the sign-up sheet and the Friday pack.

trailerGuy.setup: Founder treating Saturday as a second Monday.
trailerGuy.surprise: Missing. The pack count is a stall.
trailerGuy.punch: Soft. Weekend energy is not a new week.
tags: Weekend energy, same week, same toilets.
trailerGuy.button: Sacramento has a Saturday. The mic doesn't double the autopsy because you can smell the bars.
trailerGuy.verdict: Died as a weekend. Make Saturday the comic who counted the missing nights and ignored the lock.
fixedVersions: Saturday opened and I still owed Monday's silence.
The weekend is here. The week did not blink.
New day. Same week. I still haven't bombed in public.
